  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter used by org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter
    Class
    Description
    BoundaryReason
    Why a RequestBoundary refused a request.
    BoundaryResult
    The outcome of RequestBoundary.check(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest): either allowed, or a rejection carrying the reason, the HTTP status to answer with, and a message safe to return to the caller.
    CsrfBoundary
    The cross-site request forgery boundary for an application reachable from the network: decides whether a state-changing request came from this application's own page, or from a client that is not a browser, and refuses it when it came from some other site's page.
    CsrfBoundary.Builder
    Builder for CsrfBoundary.
    CsrfBoundary.ForwardedSource
    The one header family whose forwarded origin the boundary trusts.
    CsrfBoundary.NonBrowser
    How an unsafe request with neither Origin nor Sec-Fetch-Site is treated.
    CsrfBoundary.OriginSource
    Where the request's own origin, which Origin must equal, comes from.
    CsrfTokens
    Where a CSRF synchronizer token comes from, and how it is masked for embedding and checked on the way back.
    CsrfTokens.PerSession
    The per-session strategy: the token is HMAC-SHA256(key, UTF-8(sessionId)).
    HandshakeHosts
    The Host values of a WebSocket handshake; over RFC 8441 with no Host, one value from the request URI's authority.
    LoopbackBoundary
    The request-authenticity half of a loopback application's write protection: decides whether a request came from the page this process served, and refuses it when it did not.
    LoopbackBoundary.Builder
    Builder for LoopbackBoundary.
    RequestBoundary
    Decides whether a request came from a page this application served, and supplies the CSRF token such a page embeds.
    RequestBoundaryFilter
    Applies a RequestBoundary to every request reaching the servlet container, rejecting those that did not come from a page this application served.
    RequestIdFilter
    Thin configuration façade over the always-on request-id correlation resolver.
    RequestIdFilter.Builder
    Builder for RequestIdFilter.
    SynchronizerToken
    A server-held CSRF token: a secret minted in this process's memory, embedded into the pages this process serves, and required back on every state-changing request.
